name: Mobile County Democratic Party (Mobile County Democratic Executive Committee)
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Its site: "The Mobile County Democratic Executive Committee (MCDEC) is the official Democratic Party organization for Mobile County, Alabama" (https://mobiledemocrats.org/).

name: Mobile County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization (the county unit of the Alabama Republican Party). Its website (mobilegop.org) blocked automated reading, so no slate page was read.

name: Lagniappe (Mobile weekly newspaper)
lean_basis: Not rated. The recorded description says: "the largest independently owned weekly newspaper in Mobile". This does not establish a position on the political scale. Source: https://www.lagniappemobile.com/site/about.html.

name: Mobile Area Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Our reading of its stated mission: "serving as a proactive change agent for business needs to drive regional economic prosperity". Source: https://mobilechamber.com/about/
